issue.title: Render Bob hand-parsed leaf help in the shared clap style
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-46.3 note #4; explicitly deferred in plan:202610/bob_command_tree.md. nightly, pomodoro status/tmux/notify, and task archive retain hand-written usage/Optional Arguments help with dash underlines, while root and runner groups use clap sections and styles. Reuse the existing completion descriptors or shared presentation to align native help with clap-rendered help and cli_styles. Preserve parsing, defaults, exit codes, canonical diagnostics, legacy alias parity, and embedded fallback script behavior. Update existing help assertions/snapshots and inspect color/NO_COLOR output. The root cause is duplicate hand-written help renderers in nightly.rs, pomodoro.rs, notify.rs, and collect_done/mod.rs, so this is bounded medium presentation work.

task_type_fields.proposal: Restyle native hand-parsed help for nightly, pomodoro status/tmux/notify, and task archive to match the shared clap-rendered help.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The command-tree epic made routing and names canonical; its plan explicitly deferred full hand-parsed-help restyling as an R8 feature.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-46.3 note #4 records the explicitly deferred R8 hand-parsed help recommendation. Its bounded presentation work can be implemented independently of routing.
